candidate_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'})
MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(other:Spec)
WHERE other.specNumber IS NOT NULL AND other.specNumber <> '38.214'
RETURN other.specNumber AS affectedSpec, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount
ORDER BY crCount DESC, affectedSpec ASC
